description: To carry forward the AI/ML project undertaken in Project-I to completion, with full implementation, evaluation, and documentation, demonstrating readiness for industry or research.

syllabus.title: Project Work
syllabus.body: Continuation and completion of the project initiated in Project-I: refined implementation, thorough testing and evaluation, and final documentation and presentation.
